title: macOS: Crash when importing PBR textures (MDImmediateLibrary)
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.7.dev.custom_build [bf95b6258]

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (bf95b6258) - macOS Tahoe (26.3.0) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 Max (Apple7) - Apple M1 Max (10 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

The Godot editor intermittently crashes when importing certain textures. 

**After hitting this a few times, I started launching Godot in a debugger to catch a backtrace, which is below.**


Example PBR textures: 

(I've confirmed these CC-0 textures can be downloaded without creating any sort of account or logging in.  They are larger than the 10MB max described in the issue template.)

"Office Ceiling" 2K PNG
https://ambientcg.com/get?file=OfficeCeiling001_2K-PNG.zip

"Carpet 012" 2K PNG
https://ambientcg.com/get?file=Carpet012_2K-PNG.zip

Small, trivial textures seem to not trigger this, but that could be coincidental. 

### Steps to reproduce

- Unzip either of the above texture packs.
- Drag the folder into the FileSystem dock 
- OR, outside of the editor, move the texture directory to a Godot project folder

The editor will probably crash during import.  I hit roughly 60%.

If the editor does crash, it may crash again on restarting Godot as it tries to import the PNGs again.

Godot was compiled with:

```
platform=macos arch=arm64 vulkan=no opengl3=no metal=yes debug_symbols=yes
```
